chart.title: Cost of space launches to low Earth orbit
chart.note: Small vehicles carry up to 2,000 kg to [low Earth orbit](#dod:low_earth_orbit), medium ones between 2,000 and 20,000 kg, and heavy ones more than 20,000 kg. This data is expressed in constant 2021 US$.

Launch cost per kilogram of payload.descriptionShort: Cost to launch one kilogram of payload mass to [low Earth orbit](#dod:low_earth_orbit) as part of a dedicated launch. This data is adjusted for inflation.
